detail_text: This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal proposals or quotes.Â Solicitation, 36C24626Q0402, will be issued on or about 7 April 2026.Â The Department of Veterans Affairs, Salisbury VAMC, Salisbury, NC has a requirement for a Mobile Lithotripsy Trailor and Service Â Â This acquisition is full and open competitionÂ The applicable NAICS Code is 622110 with a size standard of $47 million.Â All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to Amy.Balicat@va.gov.Â Â Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted.Â Â Â Â Â Offerors are responsible for downloading all documents including amendments from Contracting Opportunities at sam.gov website without further notification from the Contracting Officer.Â
